description: This file defines the EventStrategy interface used for handling events in a persistent actor within the Eclipse Ditto project. It specifies a contract for applying events to entities with support for handling different event types and entity states.

classes.name: EventStrategy
classes.description: A functional interface representing a strategy for handling events of type E on entities of type S.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Applies an event to an entity, possibly modifying it and returning the updated entity, or null if no strategy applies.
